Cartoonish, Exaggerated Characters • The people are depicted with exaggerated expressions and features. • Their joyful gestures emphasize movement and sociability. 4. Simple, Suggestive Details • Objects like food, drink, and holiday hats are rendered with minimal detail but remain easily recognizable. • No shading or depth--everything is flat and symbolic. 5. Mid-Century Modern Influence • The overall aesthetic recalls vintage advertising or editorial illustrations from the 1950s-60s, particularly European modernism.
